read_intent.method: After key-only counts, compare each officially wrong shared key to the same public reference-tool default under official normalization, on both-primary-correct and system-primary-correct scopes. Inspect top repeated device-id value pairs as post-hoc explanatory examples only, never runtime rules. Use only already-admitted primary reference and output values; no transcripts, scoring, new metrics or configuration change.

public_identifier_availability.scope: CPU source inspection only; string presence of published default ID is not contextual entity resolution, normative fallback authority or ground-truth runtime access.
